new_text.skip_step: No sign-in needed. Skip the rest of the current wait for one dish: a dish still waiting to go in starts now, and a dish that is cooking finishes now. Only works after the person has tapped Start on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key.

new_text.toise_proprietaire: Qui possède ce terrain, cet immeuble ou cette rue : sociétés, SCI, bailleurs et collectivités propriétaires d'une adresse, d'une parcelle ou d'une commune. new_text.toise_reseau_client: Mon réseau : mes points privés (CSV d'adresses) rattachés aux zones, et les IRIS ou communes qui ressemblent à mes meilleurs sites. Actions importer (BAN), lister, supprimer un lot, rattacher (paramètres de zone de chalandise), similaires (7 indicateurs INSEE, écarts expliqués), zones_blanches (comm

new_text.toise_societe: Qui est cette société : fiche, dirigeants publiés au registre, établissements, comptes et annonces légales, à partir d'un nom ou d'un SIREN. Par siren (fiche, dirigeants, BODACC) ou par nom (candidats, sans choisir). Aucune coordonnée ; ni mandats d'une personne, ni filiales.

new_text.answer_invitation: Return the Starcovery page that opens the person's invitations, for the person to join or decline one from list_received_invitations in their signed-in browser. Opening the page answers nothing. Needs a credential.
new_text.change_member_role: Return the Starcovery page that opens the members of the caller's organization, for the person to give a member the admin or member role in their signed-in browser. Opening the page changes nothing. Only admins may call it. Needs a credential.
new_text.create_api_key: Mint a new API key. Only an organization admin can mint one; a member is refused. Returns the plaintext key once; it is not shown again. The new key is an ordinary key of the same member, not a child of the minting key: revoking the minting key leaves it working. Needs a credential other than an OAu
new_text.create_organization: Return the Starcovery page that opens the Create organization dialog, for the person to name and create the organization in their signed-in browser. Opening the page changes nothing. Needs a credential.
new_text.delete_organization: Return the Starcovery page that asks the person to type the organization name and delete the caller's organization, with its campaigns, Lists, and credits, in their signed-in browser. Opening the page deletes nothing. Only an admin may call it. Needs a credential.
new_text.get_organization: Read the caller's organization: its name, the caller's role, the members with their id, name, email address, and roles, the invitations it has sent that are still open, whether the caller is its only admin, and the reason it cannot be deleted, if any. Needs a credential.
new_text.invite_member: Return the Starcovery page that opens the members of the caller's organization, for the person to invite the address with the role in their signed-in browser. Opening the page sends nothing. Only admins may call it. Needs a credential.
new_text.leave_organization: Return the Starcovery page that opens the caller's organization settings, for the person to leave the organization in their signed-in browser. Opening the page changes nothing. Needs a credential.
new_text.list_api_keys: List API keys for the active organization (id, name, prefix, timestamps). An admin sees every key; a member sees only the keys they created. Never returns plaintext keys. Needs a credential other than an OAuth access token.
new_text.open_billing_portal: Open the Stripe billing portal of the caller's organization, and return its page for the person to open. Only organization admins may call it, and an organization that has never bought credits returns a tool error. Needs a credential.
new_text.remove_member: Return the Starcovery page that opens the members of the caller's organization, for the person to remove a member in their signed-in browser. The member then loses access, and the API keys they created stop working. Opening the page removes nothing. Only admins may call it. Needs a credential.
new_text.rename_account: Return the Starcovery page that opens the account settings, for the person to type the new full name and save it in their signed-in browser. Opening the page changes nothing. Needs a credential.
new_text.rename_organization: Return the Starcovery page that opens the caller's organization settings, for the person to type the new name and save it in their signed-in browser. Opening the page changes nothing. Only admins may call it. Needs a credential.
new_text.revoke_api_key: Revoke an API key by id. An admin revokes any key of the organization; a member revokes only a key they created, and another key returns not_found. Irreversible, and touches only that key: keys minted with it stay enabled until revoked by id. Needs a credential other than an OAuth access token.
new_text.revoke_invitation: Return the Starcovery page that opens the members of the caller's organization with its open invitations, for the person to revoke one in their signed-in browser. Opening the page revokes nothing. An invitation id outside the organization's open invitations returns not_found. Needs a credential.
new_text.sign_out_other_sessions: Return the Starcovery page that opens the account security settings, for the person to sign out the sessions of their other browsers in their signed-in browser. Opening the page signs out nothing. Needs a credential.
new_text.start_credit_checkout: Start a Stripe Checkout for one prepaid credit pack for the caller's organization, and return its page for the person to open and pay there. Nothing is charged until they pay on that page. Only organization admins may call it. Needs a credential.

new_text.wait_for_changes: Wait up to 20 seconds for a newer shared revision. Returns changed=false on timeout; otherwise the current state. Use while collaborating with the user, then inspect their changes before the next edit.

Leave a group, or remove an address from it.

Change your username, display name or both. Ask your user first.

new_text.scenario.get: Requires scenarioId returned by scenario.list. Returns the graph and presets. Next tool is simulation.create with scenarioId or the hydrated graph. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/scenario.get
new_text.scenario.list: No prerequisites. Cards return scenarioId (alias of id) for scenario.get, then simulation.create. Keep filters and detailed unchanged; pass nextCursor as cursor until null. Default limit 8, max 20. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/scenario.list
new_text.simulation.create: Use scenarioId from scenario.list or resources/connections, not both. Returns id for simulation.step. Check for a committed create before retrying a timeout. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.create/core
new_text.simulation.delete: The likely next tool is simulation.create to use the freed slot. Prerequisite: a simulationId from simulation.create, or an active simulation in the preserved MCP session. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.delete
new_text.simulation.from_input: Discovery only; write key. DaemonSet: placement.workers/podSlotsPerWorker. id → simulation.step. cwm://guides/public/simulation.from_input/core
new_text.simulation.inject_failure: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Use resourceId or resourceName to target a resource. Returns updated state; next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.recover_resource. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.inject_failure
new_text.simulation.inject_traffic: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Choose targetRps, deltaPercent, ramp, or random:true. Returns applied traffic; next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.inject_traffic
new_text.simulation.metrics: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Reads compact/latest or full history without stepping. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.metrics/core
new_text.simulation.recover_resource: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Use resourceId or resourceName for reversible resource recovery. Returns recovery progress; next tool is simulation.step, then simulation.metrics. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.recover_resource
new_text.simulation.step: Use simulationId from simulation.create or current demo. Returns completed steps and currentStep; next tool is simulation.metrics. Retry with the same operationId and inputs. Keyless demo. cwm://guides/public/simulation.step/core

new_text.get_place: One place with its path (ancestors, country first). Works without a key within a daily free quota.

Sent gzip-compressed when the client accepts gzip. A reply over 200 KB, or detail=full, is not inlined: the result is its REST URL and si
new_text.get_timezone: IANA timezone of a point (timezone-boundary-builder polygons: land and territorial waters) with the current UTC offset, DST flag and local time; match is none on the open sea. `dst` is true when the zone's clocks are advanced at that instant: its offset is the larger of the two it shows in that year
new_text.list_places: Children of a place (`parent`) or a name prefix search (`q`); exactly one of the two. Works without a key within a daily free quota.
new_text.lookup_postal_code: The places of a postal code (GeoNames); case, spaces and hyphens in the code are ignored. `partial` is true for the countries GeoNames gives only in part (CA, NL, GB: first part; CL, CN, AR: first digits; IE, MT: first letters; BR: major codes). 503 NOT_READY on a dataset built before the feature.
